name: One-Skillet Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken (Marry Me Chicken)

ingredients.name: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs, patted dry
kosher salt, plus more to taste
grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, plus more for garnish

instructions.primary_message: Season chicken thighs evenly with kosher salt and pepper. (For even better seasoning and crispier skin, let chicken stand at room temperature for at least 45 minutes, or refrigerate uncovered for up to 24 hours.) Place chicken, skin side down, into a room-temperature 12-inch skillet. Set over medium heat and cook, undisturbed, until fat is rendered and skin is light golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Continue cooking, flipping every 2 to 3 minutes, until thighs are deeply golden and cooked through to at least 175°F, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Reserve 1 tablespoon of the drippings in skillet, and discard remaining chicken fat (or save for another use).
Add shallot, thyme, oregano, and crushed red pepper to skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until shallot starts to soften, about 2 minutes.

Add sun-dried tomatoes and garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute. Add tomato paste and stir to coat vegetables. Cook, stirring constantly, until paste slightly darkens in color, about 1 minute.

Add wine and cook, using a wooden spoon to scrape up any flavorful bits from the bottom of the skillet, until slightly reduced, about 1 minute. Stir in broth and bring to a simmer. Cook until reduced by half, about 4 minutes.

Whisk cream into sauce and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Simmer, whisking constantly, until sauce begins to thicken, about 2 minutes. Remove skillet from heat and whisk in parmesan until melted and creamy, and sauce is thickened. Season sauce to taste with kosher salt and pepper, if needed.
Nestle cooked chicken skin side up into sauce. Garnish with more parmesan and fresh basil, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: marry me chicken, One-Skillet Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken, tuscan-style chicken

description: Marry Me Chicken gets an upgrade with crispy chicken thighs and a creamy, sun-dried tomato sauce with garlic, Parmesan, and fresh herbs.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Torn basil leaves, for garnish

Make-ahead and storage: For the crispiest skin, cook the chicken just before serving. Leftover chicken and sauce can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 1 week, though the skin will soften during storage.
author: Leah Colins
